unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.cause: An error occurred in the interface. Retry; if it persists, check the technical details.

internal_error.title: Internal server error
internal_error.cause: The backend hit an unexpected error. The detail is in the service log (journalctl -u pkm) with the request id shown.

network_error.title: Server not reachable
network_error.cause: The browser cannot reach the PKM backend. Check the network or that the pkm service is running.

client_timeout.title: The request took too long
client_timeout.cause: The backend did not answer in time: Kubernetes or Podman may be slow.

bad_request.title: Invalid request
bad_request.cause: The operation cannot be performed in the current state.

validation_failed.title: Invalid data
validation_failed.cause: Some values are not correct: check the fields listed.

unauthorized.title: Sign-in required
unauthorized.cause: The session is invalid or expired. Please sign in again.

forbidden.title: Operation not allowed
forbidden.cause: Your role does not allow this operation. Ask an administrator if you need it.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.cause: The requested item does not exist (it may have been deleted).

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.cause: The item already exists or was changed by someone else meanwhile.

confirmation_required.title: Confirmation required
confirmation_required.cause: This operation needs an explicit confirmation.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.cause: Request limit exceeded. Retry in {{retryAfter}} seconds.

service_unavailable.title: Service unavailable
service_unavailable.cause: A required component is not available.

not_supported.title: Not supported
not_supported.cause: This feature is not available for this resource or on this cluster.

setup_token.title: Invalid setup token
setup_token.cause: Use the token shown at the end of the installation or generate a new one with: sudo pkm-admin setup-token

k8s_not_configured.title: Kubernetes not configured
k8s_not_configured.cause: PKM has no Kubernetes connection configured (kubeconfig missing, unreadable or unknown context). Configure it in Settings → Kubernetes.

k8s_unavailable.title: Cannot get the cluster status
k8s_unavailable.cause: The backend cannot talk to the Kubernetes API server (server down, network, firewall or invalid TLS certificate).

k8s_timeout.title: Kubernetes does not answer in time
k8s_timeout.cause: The Kubernetes API server is slow or unreachable. The cluster may be overloaded.

k8s_auth_failed.title: Kubernetes credentials rejected
k8s_auth_failed.cause: The token or certificate used by PKM is invalid or expired. Update the kubeconfig of the pkm service account.

k8s_forbidden.title: Insufficient Kubernetes permissions
k8s_forbidden.cause: The Kubernetes account used by PKM lacks the RBAC permissions for this operation. Check the applied ClusterRole (deploy/kubernetes/pkm-rbac.yaml).

k8s_not_found.title: Resource not found
k8s_not_found.cause: The resource no longer exists in the cluster: it may have been deleted or replaced (for example a re-created Pod).

k8s_conflict.title: Conflict with the cluster state
k8s_conflict.cause: The resource already exists or is managed by another tool (field conflict). An administrator can force the apply.

k8s_invalid.title: Kubernetes rejected the configuration
k8s_invalid.cause: The configuration is not valid for Kubernetes. Read the fields listed and fix them.

k8s_unsupported.title: Resource type not supported
k8s_unsupported.cause: This resource type or API version is not available on this cluster or not managed by PKM.

podman_not_configured.title: Podman not configured
podman_not_configured.cause: The Podman integration is disabled or the socket address is invalid. Configure it in Settings → Podman.

podman_unavailable.title: Podman not reachable
podman_unavailable.cause: The Podman API socket does not answer. Check that podman.socket is active (systemctl status podman.socket) and that the pkm user can access it.

podman_timeout.title: Podman does not answer in time
podman_timeout.cause: The Podman service is slow or stuck.

podman_not_found.title: Container or image not found
podman_not_found.cause: The item no longer exists on this host.

podman_error.title: Podman returned an error
podman_error.cause: Podman could not complete the operation.

metrics_unavailable.title: Advanced metrics not configured
metrics_unavailable.cause: The requested metrics source (Prometheus) is not configured or not reachable. Metrics are never invented.
